purpose: Public-law defensive compliance matrix describing legal authority, evidence classes, procedural safeguards and provider-cooperation duties relevant to data/tool risk review. It is not an operational surveillance manual and must not be used for investigation evasion, identity concealment, evidence destruction or defeating lawful access.

authority_layers.name: 中华人民共和国刑事诉讼法（现行）
authority_layers.review_role: Primary legal framework for criminal investigation powers, evidence and procedural safeguards.

authority_layers.name: 公安机关办理刑事案件程序规定（2020修正）
authority_layers.review_role: Operational procedural framework for public-security criminal cases; verify current text before high-stakes reliance.

authority_layers.name: 关于办理刑事案件收集提取和审查判断电子数据若干问题的规定
authority_layers.review_role: Primary electronic-evidence collection, integrity, transfer and admissibility reference.

authority_layers.name: 中华人民共和国网络安全法（2025修正，2026-01-01施行）
authority_layers.review_role: Current cybersecurity baseline, including lawful technical-support and assistance duties.

authority_layers.name: 中华人民共和国数据安全法
authority_layers.review_role: Data acquisition legality and law-enforcement data-request boundary; lawful requests require prescribed approval procedures.

authority_layers.name: 中华人民共和国个人信息保护法
authority_layers.review_role: Personal-information baseline, including special limits on state-organ processing to statutory authority, procedure and necessary scope.

authority_layers.name: 网络数据安全管理条例
authority_layers.review_role: Current network-data governance and regulatory-supervision framework.

authority_layers.name: 中华人民共和国反电信网络诈骗法
authority_layers.review_role: Special anti-fraud rules for telecom, internet, financial and platform records, risk monitoring and lawful assistance.

authority_layers.name: 公安机关办理行政案件程序规定（2018修正）
authority_layers.review_role: Administrative-case evidence and investigation procedure; verify against later amendments and current substantive law.

authority_layers.name: 中华人民共和国治安管理处罚法（2025修订，2026-01-01施行）
authority_layers.review_role: Current substantive public-security administration law; use together with the current administrative-case procedure rules.

authority_layers.name: 中华人民共和国反不正当竞争法（2025修订）
authority_layers.review_role: Commercial/platform data acquisition and competition-risk boundary.

authority_layers.name: 中华人民共和国保守国家秘密法（2024修订）及实施条例
authority_layers.review_role: Independent state-secret redline; overrides ordinary public-data assumptions when applicable.

evidence_and_investigative_categories.name: 身份、账号与现实主体关联
evidence_and_investigative_categories.legal_view: Electronic-evidence rules recognize user registration, identity-authentication and related records; network identity may be assessed together with IP, network activity, terminal attribution and other evidence.
evidence_and_investigative_categories.defensive_use: Assess whether a tool/account action can reasonably be linked to a real person or organization.

evidence_and_investigative_categories.name: 网络、平台与服务日志
evidence_and_investigative_categories.legal_view: Electronic evidence can include communication records, login logs and other service records. Some specialized laws require traceable service logs in defined contexts.
evidence_and_investigative_categories.defensive_use: Model what audit trails may exist and whether retention/provenance controls are needed.

evidence_and_investigative_categories.name: 通信与内容类电子数据
evidence_and_investigative_categories.legal_view: Electronic evidence can include SMS, email, instant messages, group communications, public web content, cloud files and other electronic files when lawfully collected.
evidence_and_investigative_categories.defensive_use: Identify content classes that need privacy, secrecy and provenance controls.

evidence_and_investigative_categories.name: 资金流、交易与支付记录
evidence_and_investigative_categories.legal_view: Transaction records are recognized electronic evidence; anti-fraud law establishes special mechanisms for suspicious-account monitoring and lawful fund query, stop-payment, freeze and return.
evidence_and_investigative_categories.defensive_use: Assess payment-account attribution and transaction audit exposure for lawful compliance review.

evidence_and_investigative_categories.name: 设备、本地文件与原始存储介质
evidence_and_investigative_categories.legal_view: Rules address seizure/sealing of original storage media, extraction when media cannot be seized, backups, integrity checks and examination of electronic files.
evidence_and_investigative_categories.defensive_use: Preserve lawful records and understand chain-of-custody requirements.

evidence_and_investigative_categories.name: 网络在线数据与远程电子数据
evidence_and_investigative_categories.legal_view: The electronic-evidence framework recognizes online extraction and defines remote network examination as an investigation activity subject to legal procedure.
evidence_and_investigative_categories.defensive_use: Classify remotely hosted evidence and require source/time/integrity documentation.

evidence_and_investigative_categories.name: 依法调取与平台/运营商协助
evidence_and_investigative_categories.legal_view: Data Security Law requires prescribed strict approval for public-security or state-security data requests; cybersecurity and anti-fraud laws impose defined technical-support or assistance duties in lawful cases.
evidence_and_investigative_categories.defensive_use: Assess whether provider-held records may be lawfully requested and whether internal response procedures are needed.

evidence_and_investigative_categories.name: 勘验检查、搜查、查封扣押与证据保全
evidence_and_investigative_categories.legal_view: Criminal and administrative procedures contain legally defined investigation and preservation measures with procedural requirements.
evidence_and_investigative_categories.defensive_use: Map procedural provenance and legal-authority checkpoints, not physical countermeasures.

evidence_and_investigative_categories.name: 查询、冻结与数据保全
evidence_and_investigative_categories.legal_view: Criminal procedure and special anti-fraud rules provide lawful query/freeze mechanisms; electronic-evidence rules also recognize freezing electronic data to preserve integrity.
evidence_and_investigative_categories.defensive_use: Understand legal preservation exposure and maintain accurate auditable records.

evidence_and_investigative_categories.name: 鉴定、辨认与专门性审查
evidence_and_investigative_categories.legal_view: Criminal and administrative procedures provide appraisal/identification mechanisms; electronic-data specialized issues may require qualified technical explanation or appraisal.
evidence_and_investigative_categories.defensive_use: Separate raw evidence from expert interpretation and preserve methodological provenance.

evidence_and_investigative_categories.name: 技术侦查的法定门槛
evidence_and_investigative_categories.legal_view: Criminal Procedure Law permits technical investigation only for statutorily specified serious cases after strict approval, within approved type, target and duration; unrelated material is subject to legal handling restrictions.
evidence_and_investigative_categories.defensive_use: Recognize that technical investigation exists as a tightly governed legal category; no implementation or avoidance details are provided.

evidence_and_investigative_categories.name: 行政监管检查
evidence_and_investigative_categories.legal_view: Network-data regulators may, within statutory authority, request explanations, inspect or copy relevant records and inspect security measures/equipment; unrelated business information should not be collected under the network-data regulation.
evidence_and_investigative_categories.defensive_use: Prepare a documented compliance response and data-minimization boundary.

evidence_and_investigative_categories.name: 跨来源关联与同一性判断
evidence_and_investigative_categories.legal_view: Identity and fact patterns may be assessed by combining multiple lawful records rather than relying on one identifier alone.
evidence_and_investigative_categories.defensive_use: Use a multi-signal attribution model when deciding whether a tool action is reasonably attributable to the user.

evidence_and_investigative_categories.name: 完整性、证据链与可采性
evidence_and_investigative_categories.legal_view: Electronic evidence is reviewed for authenticity, legality and relevance; integrity can be supported by original media sealing, hashes, backups, video records, freeze/access logs, digital signatures/certificates and reproducible collection records.
evidence_and_investigative_categories.defensive_use: Preserve provenance and distinguish legally meaningful evidence from unverified screenshots or transformed data.

evidence_and_investigative_categories.name: 权利保护、保密与用途限制
evidence_and_investigative_categories.legal_view: State organs and investigators remain subject to statutory authority, procedure, necessity, confidentiality and use restrictions; state secrets, commercial secrets, personal privacy and personal information receive additional protection.
evidence_and_investigative_categories.defensive_use: Check both investigative authority and limits; lawful authority does not eliminate purpose, scope or confidentiality constraints.

final_rule: YuanDian broadens recall; current official law, regulation, judicial/procuratorial/public-security material and applicable provider terms control final conclusions. Unknown validity or supersession status is REVIEW_BEFORE_PRODUCTION.
